steps.legato: Legato means smooth and connected: keep each key down until the next one goes down, so there’s no silence between the notes. A curved line over the notes, a slur, asks for it. With a MIDI keyboard, the app checks it.
steps.legatoUpDown: Up and down under one slur: lift each finger just as the next one plays.
steps.phrases: Slurs also shape the music into phrases, like sentences. At the end of a slur, lift the hand a little before the next one starts: a small breath.
steps.auraLee: “Aura Lee”, an American song from 1861, in {g} major: four smooth phrases, each under its slur. Remember {fSharp}.
steps.auraLeeInTime: Now in time, singing each phrase.
